# spyro php

Manage PHP on remote server.

## Before you run it

`php version/extensions/fpm-status/info/restart`. `info -o memory_limit` greps `php -i`; for `php --ini` use `spyro run`.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro php`

```text
Usage: spyro php [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage PHP on remote server.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  extensions  List PHP extensions.
  fpm-status  Show PHP-FPM status (pools, processes).
  info        Show PHP configuration.
  restart     Restart PHP-FPM.
  version     Show PHP version.
```

### `spyro php extensions`

```text
Usage: spyro php extensions [OPTIONS]

  List PHP extensions.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  -f, --filter TEXT   Filter extensions (grep pattern)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro php fpm-status`

```text
Usage: spyro php fpm-status [OPTIONS]

  Show PHP-FPM status (pools, processes).

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro php info`

```text
Usage: spyro php info [OPTIONS]

  Show PHP configuration.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  -o, --option TEXT   Specific ini option (e.g. memory_limit)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro php restart`

```text
Usage: spyro php restart [OPTIONS]

  Restart PHP-FPM.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --timeout FLOAT     Timeout in seconds (default: 30)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
